note: The checked-in starting corpus for scripts/numerics.py coverage-sweep. It spans character classes, code, numerals, non-Latin scripts, long documents and repetition. These prompts are candidates only: the sweep measures each one against the dump and keeps it only when its forward reaches a slot no earlier kept prompt reached. The generator in the same tool adds a deterministic larger corpus with --generate.
